item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00212","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C16","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied concrete drafting machinery for the child. Both directives first define surveyed areas containing public and non-public lands and report their aggregate acreage, then provide that, subject to existing rights, the public lands within those areas are withdrawn from appropriation under the public-land laws and reserved for a specified federal purpose. This close combination of language, land-description structure, and operative sequence is materially stronger than a merely shared public-land topic. C16 and C14 contain related monument-enlargement and reservation formulas, but neither parallels the child's public/non-public-area distinction and subsequent treatment of only the public lands as closely as C09.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The areas described, including both public and non-public lands, aggregate 2.280 acres.","parent_excerpt":"The area described, including both public and non-public lands, aggregates approximately 835,759 acres.","explanation":"Distinctive shared formulation describing an encompassing surveyed area that includes both public and private holdings and states aggregate acreage."},{"child_excerpt":"Subject to valid existing rights, the public lands within the above-described areas are hereby withdrawn from all forms of appropriation under the public-land laws, including the mining and mineral-leasing laws","parent_excerpt":"Subject to valid existing rights and withdrawals ... the public lands within the following-described areas ... are hereby withdrawn from all forms of appropriation under the public land laws, except the mining and mineral-leasing laws","explanation":"Nearly identical operative withdrawal formula, with the mining-law treatment altered to fit the new reservation."},{"child_excerpt":"and reserved as a part of the said Naval Petroleum Reserve No. 1.","parent_excerpt":"and reserved for use, administration, and disposition in accordance with the provisions of Title III of the said Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act","explanation":"Both complete the withdrawal provision by reserving the affected public lands for the directive's newly specified federal purpose."}]}
